description: Election Commission - H. C. Rathwaththa elected as Chairman of the Ipalogama Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for the office of Chairman of the Ipalogama Pradeshiya Sabha under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including the nomination and declaration of an elected official to fill a vacancy caused by death, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
